FACT_ID: sec04-R01 | anchor: A01
Changes update the record, replacements reissue the card, and address reports do neither by themselves [A01].
Why it matters: group renewal-paths; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec04-F01, sec04-F04, sec04-F06 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec04-R02 | anchor: A01
A move starts a ten-day report clock but buys no card, while the optional replacement card costs a fee [A01].
Why it matters: group address-change; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec04-F02, sec04-F04 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec04-R03 | anchor: A01
Online routing splits three ways: license services for updates and reissues, the address page for moves, and the field office as fallback [A01].
Why it matters: group renewal-paths; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec04-F01, sec04-F03, sec04-F06 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec04-R04 | anchor: A01
Stranded out of state, request a one-year extension by email before expiry, unless the license is limited-term [A01].
Why it matters: group extensions; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec04-F10, sec04-F11 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec04-R05 | anchor: A01
Expired cards forbid driving and superseded cards forbid keeping, so destroy the old one when the new one lands [A01].
Why it matters: group card-validity; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec04-F05, sec04-F09 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec04-R06 | anchor: A01
Issuance can demand fresh identity proof when expiry dates collide, plus a parent or guardian signature for minors [A01].
Why it matters: group issuance; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec04-F07, sec04-F08 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0014]
